en.headline: Security engineer who has run financial-sector security infrastructure and SIEM automation
paragraphs: My first job was tracking server patch schedules in Excel on Korea Aerospace Industries' (KAI) closed network. Repeating the same checks taught me that recurring work has to be written down as procedures and records so the result stays the same when the person doing it changes. I then earned RHCSA, LPIC-1, and Linux Master Level 2 while continuing to study Linux, and used that knowledge for operations automation at my next job.

At Metanet M Platform, I used Ansible and Python to turn contact-center NAC policy deployment into a repeatable procedure. At Jointree, I applied NSX-T microsegmentation to Kookmin University's next-generation information system to split east-west traffic policy, and reorganized the NAC and DLP detection policies. In both places, I left recurring manual work behind as scripts and documents.

At Quantec Investment Management's Financial Security Data Center (FSDC), I handled Financial Supervisory Service periodic audits. What mattered in the audits was less the settings themselves than whether I could show the current state and change history as evidence, so I kept change records for DB access-control query tuning and PB platform POC validation as well.

Most recently, I worked on the Nextrade trading system security track continuously from the build phase at Gaonnuri Information System through the automation phase at ITCEN CTS. I built network segmentation and endpoint security, managed appliance configuration with Ansible Roles, and handled the Korean Financial Services Commission main-license review. In the automation phase, I connected Splunk ES detection rules, alert workflows, and FortiManager API policy lookups so that event detection flows automatically into alert delivery.

Now, in my homelab, I manage Cloudflare Workers, MCP, Grafana, and 1Password configuration with Terraform and am testing an approach where MCP tools classify recurring security response items first. In my next role, I want to define the security problem first, solve it with procedures and code, and leave an operating record.
en.closing: I will take on your security infrastructure work by reducing repeated tasks and leaving operating records.
